items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: around 1918, I was taking press roll lessons from Henry Martin.

ctx.x: And, well, he got his inspiration from Bunk. And I got my inspiration from Henry Martin, Black Benny, Red Happy, Baby Dodds. But Baby Dodds used to play in the Orleans during them times. Yeah. Well, after I got old enough I used to go to dances. I, wherever Baby Dodds was playing I was always there. And actually I got a lot from, learned a lot from him. Oh, sure. Yeah. Well, when I, around 1918, I was taking press roll lessons from Henry Martin. Yeah. He was a left-hander like me.

items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: Well Henry Martin he'd done the best he could for me when I was trying to learn

ctx.x: Had you played any other instruments first? Any like guitar? No, no other instruments.
I was just crazy about drums from a child when Baby Dots was playing in New Orleans at that time. Baby Dots, Henry Martin, Black Benny, Two Bits, and all those drummers.
Well tell me, I don't want to interrupt you all the time, but tell me about Two Bits. I know Bunk used to mention Two Bits, and I never heard anybody else mention it until you did.
